job.question: According to the INREV Due Diligence Questionnaire for Non-Listed Real Estate Investment Vehicles, when was the questionnaire first launched and in which years was it updated?
job.expected_facts: It was first launched in April 2007 and updated in 2010, 2014 and most recently in 2018. The 2018 version introduced a phased approach with Preliminary, Advanced and Supplementary stages.
job.acceptance: Accept April 2007 and 2010/2014/2018. Phased approach and stage labels are not required.

reviews.reason: This is the questionnaire for Fund of Funds and Multi-Managers, not the questionnaire for Non-Listed Real Estate Investment Vehicles. Its April 2007 date refers to the due diligence protocol, and it provides no update years for the questionnaire asked about.
quotes: The Due Diligence Questionnaire for Fund of Funds and Multi-Managers is part of the due diligence protocol which was first launched in April 2007.
This is the first version of the questionnaire.
INREV has developed separate due diligence questionnaires for non listed real estate vehicles and debt funds.
